headline.label: Jobs captured

headline.label: Jobs reviewed
headline.definition: Postings that entered the qualification/review stage in those runs. This is the SAME population as jobs captured, measured one stage later: the deduped opportunity list is handed straight to qualification, so in a run that reached enrichment the two are equal. headline.label: Review rate
headline.definition: Jobs reviewed as a percentage of jobs captured in the same runs. 100% means every captured posting entered review -- which is what a run that completed its slices looks like, because the deduped opportunity list is handed straight to qualification.
